recipe.build:
sed -r '/release \{/,/}/ { /signingConfig/d }' -i composeApp/build.gradle.kts
PROF_FILE=composeApp/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/fossRelease/compileFossReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=b9232de52f8b7b53149ade3fa4a359a9d3f521e9
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleFossRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
test -f "${PROF_FILE}"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
OUT=composeApp/build/outputs/apk/foss/release/app-foss-release.apk
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --zipalign fix-newlines "$OUT" 'META-INF/services/*' 'composeResources/*.xml' 'res/*.html' 'res/*.json'
mv "$OUT" /outputs/unsigned.apk
